title: The Count Kept in Wood

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: A firing kept in wood wants no figure put on it, and a pot set down wrong tells on itself before its time. Two counts in two materials, and neither asks the other what it cost.
epigraph.attribution: Two sayings of the Clay Yard, told in the middle tend of Smoke

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and fifty-two to two hundred and fifty-four days, six months and seventy-two days to six months and seventy-four days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing --- the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the body inventoried as a wound is inventoried, crust, gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop in the order they arrive; a pot set down wrong read as a vessel giving its note before its time and swept around; a figure arriving nowhere read as a chart turned face-down; the hand's six answerings kept as honest objects and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a key, a power or a rule --- without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no hearing beyond six, no seventh of the full note, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no sixth asking and no witness for the row question, no tenth shape of the record-first hand, no eighth green or eighth shape, no name spoken over either, no sale, no calling of the loan, no naming of a payer, no private record opened, read or copied, no figure given for the dressed grain or for the hand that did not come back, no lesson made of the one opening before Smoke 1 which is behind the household and not looked at again, and no ending.

scenes.title: The Middle Tend Earned
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap (\dropcap on the opening words): Day 252, Smoke 13, Thirdday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the kiln mouth and the loaf shelf. Open in the small hours with the hand laid down against the fold on the seventy-eighth answer and the file open on the towel; set that two-rhythm crossing down like a tool, never recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power. Count carried at 251 exact, six months and seventy-one days, told by nobody, coming into **252**, six months and seventy-two days (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-two days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the unswept corner the house calls the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell --- Smoke 13 is that morning's work, no market, no Cross and no bell, and Smoke 20 (Day 259), the second Account-day, stands seven mornings beyond the close and is unbrought. Three counts in three places --- the kiln's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, the river's note of water over water through the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot --- none rising into another, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). Body inventory: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform; the surgeon takes the inventory and enters it nowhere (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk (T058/T079). The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin, gathered by the handful and set under the fold flat; changed state, gained no figure, entered on no slate, the space between the figure once read over it and its cost still unsigned (T077). At the kiln mouth she sets a pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, half-beat at the setting, no look toward the bed; finger kept on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal tally stays unread; one glance at the clay jar cold under its glaze and the hand shut half over nothing (T100). The hand answers the first question of the chapter --- down at once on the river's next low note --- answer **seventy-nine**, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a reach, hearing, seventh, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Places Gone Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 252, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard's walked-around places, the yard well, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the finger's-width-open back room rendered only as a direction and a sound, and the bed under the roof. Afternoon thins without ending; heat settles behind the pot, under the shelf's low angle and into the fold; one crust two inches off, its gap unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek--temple--wrist, afterdrop waiting (T061/T082). Garl is kept in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and fifty-two days --- salt-stiff coat on its peg with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack, the uncalled debt against a firing of tiles circled without a name; no collector comes up or goes down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Sella carries the basket about the yard at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey called the thaw beside it, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the round ring where the shallow clay pan stood, the bare dark trough beside the well with its water called weather, the field's empty place out on the worked strips and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, not paid). Ilva may be glimpsed drawing at the yard well with the pail against her knee, clay pale in the crescents of her nails and grey rack dust in one thumb's seam; her hand stays in her sleeve, the notched birch strip is not taken out, read, asked about or joined to the reed-cutter's cord, and no tenth record-first hand is filed --- the ninth stays nine on its own tray with a finger between it and every other private keeping (T080 held, not paid). A neighbour's cost-question goes to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, refused or entered; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere (T015/T041/T047 held). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* in the tone of a man stating the weather, sets the small knife at the very edge of its sill with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it with no name on the man and no figure on the debt. The ear-sentence goes all the way to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, a remembered stopping and not a new one; nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath is drawn at the top of the reach and not spent, the loan uncalled and no collector came. Chest tight since the dark; Ash in the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line; pale clip-ring at the left wrist; the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot, which is not forgiving, its small dry scrape above the shed a direction and nothing more (T036/T076, T006). His stroke goes over the shallow bright patch on the flagstones without the half-check and over the road a house sends a man down when it wants a collector, without once turning along it. At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through before first grey with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and under the nails, white in the creases where a fist has opened and not bone-coloured slip; men unnamed went low into the back room and got no name, and he does not say the room was cold. He speaks to the wheel before any person --- *It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady* --- and to a pot *You'll do*, knows its full note three turns ahead and withholds it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them; the burned-slate word stands at four, the two shut-room tellings at two, the three pot sayings at three with no fourth likeness made a cause, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise of the boy's name neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064). His bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, takes the cold out of the fingertip, holds until the end arrives at the pot, moves a hair's breadth and is left standing --- a remembered repetition, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both. At the bed the hand answers the second question --- down before the letting-go of a borrowed count --- answer **eighty**, filed on the sixth place, an object and not a power (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Note Before Its Time
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 253, Smoke 14, Fourthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the drying racks, the loaf shelf and the boards fronting it. New day, new date, no recap: **253** exact, six months and seventy-three days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-three days (T088); the widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk (T058/T079); first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross. Smoke 20 (Day 259) stands six mornings beyond the close and is unbrought. The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin, turned, gathered by the handful and set under the fold flat; changed state, gained no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by an arm that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077). Sella lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glances once at the clay jar and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot rim out and turns its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed (T100). A neighbour's cost-question is sent to the pot and the weather with nothing priced; a man come down the clay road with a number in his fist brings it up toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and is not a missing figure (T015/T041/T047 held). **The chapter's small non-fatal edge, planted and not paid:** at the racks a pot is set down wrong, out of a woman's shadow and near the warm side of the wall, and gives its high thin note before its time --- not a full note, not a flat crack, not a seventh hearing and not the small flat knock out of a person --- and the woman sweeps around it and says something practical about the slip; the boy files the note on its own place beside the three pot sayings and makes no fourth likeness and no cause of it (T064, T061/T082). A wrong wind off High Kiln carries the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it: a direction arrived nowhere, not a second edge paid, no pot lost and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188. Sella tells the fire it is the thaw and feeds it; the fire answers four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer unnamed for two hundred and fifty-three days (T088). At the boards the hand answers the third question --- held to the river's own interval with no count in the house to borrow --- answer **eighty-one**, filed on the sixth place, not a longer reach, a hearing or a power (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the House Keeps Back
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 253, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth and kiln mouth, the salt coat and hollow wheel-seat, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the back room as a direction and a sound, the bed. Afternoon thins; heat into the fold; one stiff brown-edged crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting (T061/T082). Garl in objects, name unspoken two hundred and fifty-three days, his keeping maintenance and not a story, no collector up or down the clay road, the debt against the tiles neither paid nor settled nor done with (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, says *Yes, house* to the wood and *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife where six can be checked and the seventh cannot, and brings the ear-sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it all the way to the word that would call the loan --- the ninth stopping, a remembered stopping and not a new one --- with no figure and no name; the Seed 16 breath is drawn and not spent, nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, and the loan stays uncalled (T036/T076). His chest is tight; Ash is worked into the creases of his knuckles in the colour of the clean dark line and no scrubbing lifts it; the pale clip-ring at the left wrist holds what light there is and gives it back; above the shed the loft settling comes to the boy as a direction, and the warm stone Sella gave him in the winter Garl died lies back in its unmarked clay pot, two years gone and cold, unreconciled with the debt by not trying, which is not forgiving (T006). His stroke goes over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without turning along it. At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, parts dusty forearms from clean on one tray as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and tells a pot *You'll do* with no welcome and no unkindness in it; he knows the note that pot will give three turns ahead, with air under it and a want in it, and withholds the knowing --- the pot saying stays a saying, the burned-slate word stays at four, the two shut-room tellings at two, and no fourth likeness is made a cause (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064). When Sella's sentence goes low and unfinished at the hearth his bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of it, holds until the end arrives at the pot and is left standing --- one piece of iron and two bites with no Grathic word for both mercies, joined to no kiln and entered in no slate. The rear of the shed keeps its finger's width of open and its sound of low voices that do not resolve into words; the boy hears a direction and nothing more, and the narration does not enter the room. *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise to the slate-burners is neither given nor withdrawn. The hand answers the fourth question --- one rhythm held across the little silence after Sella's count without crossing two --- answer **eighty-two**, filed on the sixth place, not a hearing, a seventh, a payment or a rule (T061/T082).

scenes.title: Five Askings and No Witness
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 254, Smoke 15, Fifthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the drying racks and the boards fronting the shelf. New day, new date, no recap: **254** exact, six months and seventy-four days, nobody told (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-four days (T088); the widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk on any of the three days (T058/T079); first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross. Smoke 20 (Day 259) stands five mornings beyond the close and is not brought early. The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin, turned, gathered by the handful and set under the fold flat; changed state, gained no figure, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale off the coals, and the little-door burn closes on nothing and opens again to the work. At the loaf shelf she lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal tally stays unread, and sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed (T100). A neighbour's cost-question goes to the pot and the weather; a man with a number in his fist brings it up toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve (T015/T041/T047 held). **The ownerless question is not asked a sixth time:** the five askings stand on their seventh place --- Grain 21, 23, 26 and 29 and the afternoon of Smoke 8 --- with no owner, room, hand at the kiln, cause or witness, and no row named; it is not made a hearing, a fourth shaping of the pot saying, a fifth telling of the burned slate, a third telling of the shut room, a cause, a name or a row; it gathers toward the far-off day a witness stands somewhere and can be asked (T101 held at five askings, not paid). The three counts stay three: the fire's four low pulls and fifth gap under the floor, the river's water over water through the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the told bell stays beside the heard, the told figure beside the paid, with Smoke's first arithmetic gone up the clay road in Berr's locked box and answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 or the hand that went in on Seed 15 (T015/T041/T047, T077). The hand answers the fifth question --- two rhythms crossed in the inch across a wall that does not touch, one borrowed count and the little silence after it crossed against the river's own note --- answer **eighty-three**, remembered and not a change made again, filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the File Keeps
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 254, Smoke 15, Fifthday, afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth and kiln mouth, the salt coat and hollow wheel-seat, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light, the bed under the roof. Smoke goes on without a boundary drawn in the narration and neither of the district's two names for the months is set right or left wrong; Smoke 16 (Day 255) stands beyond the close and is not brought into a day that has not earned its heading. Afternoon thins; heat into the fold; one stiff brown-edged crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint; afterdrop waiting. Garl in objects, name unspoken two hundred and fifty-four days, no collector on the clay road on Smoke 13, 14 or 15 (T009/T013/T092). Sella gives the fire its instruction before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts under her breath toward no opening; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, untouched at every shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon and dusk, the one opening before Smoke 1 behind the household with no lesson made and no payer named; the next real opening, the first firing of Frost (Day 271), far off and unbrought (T058/T079). At the kindling Tarn tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife where six can be checked and the seventh cannot, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, a remembered stopping; nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, pale clip-ring at the wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, parts dust from slip, speaks to the wheel and a pot, puts the bent finger into the cold damper ahead of the unfinished sentence, knows the pot's note three turns ahead and withholds it; the burned slate stays at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with no fourth likeness made a cause, the row question at five askings with no witness, the men in the back room unnamed, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101). Then the boy turns out the file as a surgeon turns out instruments on a towel and finds it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, three pot sayings with no fourth likeness made a cause, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings on their own places, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places, nine record-first hands with a finger between every pair and Ilva's notched strip unread in her sleeve, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, dressed grain covered and unfigured, the pan's gone ring, the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps and the field's empty place on trays that do not touch, and the ownerless question at five askings with no witness and no row named (T061/T082, T080 held, T050/T051 held offstage, T033/T034 held offstage, T060/T086, T100, T098). He puts the sixth question of the chapter to his hand as the room goes quiet around the fire: the hand goes up an inch toward the low note through the finger's-width door, goes through the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of Sella's counted breaths in the room that does not touch his, keeps through the little silence after her count, and comes down on the river's next low note. Two rhythms crossed across a wall that does not touch; the coordination is remembered and not a change made again, not a longer reach, miss entered as a finding, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule. Answer **eighty-four** lies on the sixth place beside eighty-three with no payer named, and **eighty-four** honest answers stand there now, each an object and not a power. Six months and seventy-four days are told by nobody; the fire's fifth is unpaid two hundred and fifty-four days and its payer has no name; the seventh year stands at its very end and has still not given. The hand lays itself down against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, and the file lies open on the towel, exact, complete and worth nothing. Under the floor the fire stops at four and the silence where the fifth should have stood stands where it stood. Two hundred and fifty-four stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, and the count goes forward into Smoke 16, a day that has not yet earned its heading.
